title: SEC Lists Three Prospective Tokenized Securities Venues
why_it_matters: The first consolidated SEC roster reveals a third prospective venue and gives the market an official way to distinguish notification from regulatory qualification.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

SEC Lists Three Prospective Tokenized Securities Venues

The SEC now lists TSV LLC, OKXICE TSV and Kephas/Perpetuals.com as prospective operators that submitted notices under its temporary tokenized-stock framework.

Full analysis →
